strings.0aa32a9d924ef027e19dd15708e3cd3eebac1e7e: Topic 2 of EDHEC’s ‘Innovations in Finance’ capstone project falls within this framework. Set by Veolia, it focuses on the gap relative to the GreenUp targets. It asks what strategic directions and acquisitions can bridge this gap. Our scope is financial capacity. Our research question follows from this: to what extent does GreenUp’s leverage commitment limit Veolia’s acquisition capacity between now and the end of 2027? Our capacity range, set out in Appendix IV, also serves as a benchmark for the other groups. The issue also calls for maximising Veolia’s ESG contribution. This ranking of acquisitions falls to the groups operating within other scopes: ours sets the cap for them and, in part 5, measures the cost of ESG.
